title: Apply writes a WordPress site's own mailboxes: option tracy_contact_to (where the theme's contact form sends) and contact.email of tracy_site_identity (the address its theme shows)
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.

S2: From the checkout root run: node --test --test-name-pattern='contact form sends to|account that pressed Apply, which is never shown|option already right|no recipient and asked nothing' apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-residue.test.mjs — keep its last 12 lines and its exit code.
S3: Run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-residue.test.mjs — keep its last 12 lines and its exit code.
S4: Run: grep -c "kind: 'option'" apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/wp-residue.js — keep the number.
S5: Read the '# pass' and '# fail' lines of S2 and S3. A command that cannot start (missing module) is BLOCKED, not FAIL.
expect: S2: pass 4, fail 0: with a mailbox typed the sweep sets option tracy_contact_to to it and contact.email of tracy_site_identity to it; with none typed, the recipient is the account that pressed Apply (never written into the identity option) and a demo address the site showed is emptied; an option already right is not written again; an identity stored nested or as flat dotted keys keeps its shape; an option that cannot be read is said in the notes and not overwritten; a sweep given no recipient and no contact writes no option. Before the fix: 3 of the 4 fail.
S3: fail 0: the engine's other behaviour (form recipients, links, pages) is unchanged.
S4: at least 1: the sweep writes options through content.update.

selectors.code: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/wp-residue.js sweepWordPress — the `owned` options loop; identityWithEmail in wp-contacts.js
selectors.test: apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wp-residue.test.mjs 'contact form sends to', 'account that pressed Apply, which is never shown'

evidence: Ledger L17b of the Apply audit, 05/10/2026: the Tracy WordPress themes send their own contact form to option tracy_contact_to and nowhere else (never admin_email); the Build path wrote it (apply-wordpress.mjs), Apply did not, so a visitor's message through the theme's own form failed, and the kinetic theme 1.1.6 shows contact.email of tracy_site_identity, which Apply never set.
fence: Mechanism only: the sweep's calls to the content door. Not covered: a stand run of the theme's form (the kinetic 1.1.6 release is a separate step).
